results.title: Studio Ghibli: No Future? | Animation World Network
results.content:
No new feature has been announced by Ghibli since it released the Oscar-winning Boy and the Heron three years ago. True, a new short film has just debuted, A Night in the Valley of the Witches, directed by Goro Miyazaki, reportedly endorsed by his dad, Ghibli's venerated Hayao Miyazaki. But don't look for it in theaters; A Night in the Valley is currently only screening in the Ghibli Park, just outside the Japanese city of Nagoya. [...] As for Hayao Miyazaki, the 85-year-old director of Totoro, Spirited Away and The Boy and the Heron, what he's working on is undisclosed. His latest "release" was a series of three-dimensional "panorama" boxes, intricately composed dioramas with images based on his films. Like his son's short, they'll be exhibited at the Ghibli Park. They may also put paid to rumors of Ghibli's next film, prompted by some footage released in 2023. [...] Studio 4°C

results.title: Every Studio Ghibli Movie From Hayao Miyazaki in Chronological Order
results.content:
Released in Japan on July 14 under the title “How Do You Live?,” the latest film takes its name from a best-selling novel of the same name penned by Japanese author Genzaburo Yoshino. The film, which released with little promotional material, follows the journey of a 12-year-old boy named Mahito Maki as he stumbles upon a fantasy world with a talking grey heron. Studio Ghibli

Hayao Miyazaki is back! It’s been 10 years since the release of his last film, “The Wind Rises,” and now the acclaimed Studio Ghibli director returns with his supposedly final film, “The Boy and the Heron.” [...] Miyazaki, who turned 82 on Jan. 5, 2023, has once again declared that “The Boy and the Heron” will be the culmination of his career – which he said seven previous times in 1986, 1992, 1997, 2001, 2004, 2008 and 2013. After each time, he withdrew from his retirement to make another film.
